model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата представя групирана стълбовидна диаграма, която илюстрира резултатите (Score) на три модела — SRPO-7B, GRPO-7B и Qwen-2.5-VL-7B — върху четири различни бенчмарка. Хоризонталната ос е етикетирана като „Benchmark" и съдържа четири категории, подредени в следния ред отляво надясно: MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro и Physics. Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като „Score" и обхваща диапазон от 35 до 80, с равномерни интервали през 5 единици, като скалата е линейна. За всяка категория на бенчмарк са представени по три стълба, групирани един до друг, като всеки стълб съответства на един от трите модела съгласно легендата, разположена в горния десен ъгъл на диаграмата. SRPO-7B е представен с тъмносин цвят, GRPO-7B — със среден син, а Qwen-2.5-VL-7B — със светлосин. Върху всеки стълб е изписана конкретната числова стойност. За MathVista стойностите са 75.8 (SRPO-7B), 72.3 (GRPO-7B) и 68.2 (Qwen-2.5-VL-7B). За MathVerse стойностите са 55.8, 52.9 и 46.3 съответно. За MMMU-Pro стойностите са 42.3, 39.9 и 36.9. За Physics стойностите са 60.6, 53.5 и 45.4. Във всяка група от стълби SRPO-7B е най-високият, следван от GRPO-7B и след това Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. Фонът на диаграмата съдържа пунктирани решетъчни линии, които подпомагат визуалното отчитане на стойностите.
model_annotations.Chinese: This grouped bar chart compares the performance scores of three models—SRPO-7B, GRPO-7B, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B—across four benchmarks. The horizontal axis represents the benchmark categories, labeled from left to right as MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro, and Physics. The vertical axis represents the score, ranging from 35 to 80 with gridlines at intervals of 5 units. For each benchmark, three bars are grouped side by side, with SRPO-7B displayed in dark navy blue, GRPO-7B in a medium steel blue, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B in a light sky blue, as indicated by the legend in the upper right corner. On the MathVista benchmark, SRPO-7B achieves 75.8, GRPO-7B scores 72.3, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B scores 68.2. On MathVerse, SRPO-7B reaches 55.8, GRPO-7B reaches 52.9, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B reaches 46.3. On MMMU-Pro, SRPO-7B scores 42.3, GRPO-7B scores 39.9, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B scores 36.9. On Physics, SRPO-7B attains 60.6, GRPO-7B attains 53.5, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B attains 45.4. Each bar is annotated with its exact numerical value displayed above it. Within every benchmark group, the bars are consistently ordered with SRPO-7B on the left, GRPO-7B in the middle, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B on the right, and across all four benchmarks, SRPO-7B consistently has the tallest bar while Qwen-2.5-VL-7B has the shortest. The benchmarks along the horizontal axis do not appear to follow alphabetical or score-based ordering. No bars are visually emphasized through special shading, bolding, or additional annotations beyond the data labels.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the performance scores of three models—SRPO-7B, GRPO-7B, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B—across four different benchmarks. The horizontal axis represents the benchmarks, labeled in the order MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro, and Physics. The vertical axis represents the score, ranging from 35 to 80, with gridlines at intervals of 5 units. The bars are grouped by benchmark, with each group containing three bars corresponding to the three models. SRPO-7B is represented in dark navy blue, GRPO-7B in medium steel blue, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B in light blue, as indicated by the legend in the upper right corner. For the MathVista benchmark, SRPO-7B scores 75.8, GRPO-7B scores 72.3, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B scores 68.2. For MathVerse, SRPO-7B scores 55.8, GRPO-7B scores 52.9, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B scores 46.3. For MMMU-Pro, SRPO-7B scores 42.3, GRPO-7B scores 39.9, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B scores 36.9. For Physics, SRPO-7B scores 60.6, GRPO-7B scores 53.5, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B scores 45.4. Within each benchmark group, the bars are arranged with SRPO-7B on the left, GRPO-7B in the middle, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B on the right, and each bar is annotated with its exact numerical value above it. Across all four benchmarks, SRPO-7B consistently has the tallest bar, followed by GRPO-7B, and then Qwen-2.5-VL-7B with the shortest bar. The benchmarks are not sorted by score but appear in a fixed categorical order.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt einen Vergleich der Ergebnisse dreier Modelle – SRPO-7B, GRPO-7B und Qwen-2.5-VL-7B – über vier verschiedene Benchmarks hinweg. Die horizontale Achse trägt die Beschriftung „Benchmark" und enthält vier Kategorien in der Reihenfolge von links nach rechts: MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro und Physics. Die vertikale Achse ist mit „Score" beschriftet und erstreckt sich von 35 bis 80, wobei die Teilstriche in regelmäßigen Abständen von 5 Einheiten angeordnet sind. Für jeden Benchmark sind drei Balken gruppiert nebeneinander dargestellt, wobei SRPO-7B in dunklem Marineblau, GRPO-7B in mittlerem Stahlblau und Qwen-2.5-VL-7B in hellem Blau abgebildet ist, wie in der Legende oben rechts angegeben. Bei MathVista erreicht SRPO-7B einen Wert von 75,8, GRPO-7B 72,3 und Qwen-2.5-VL-7B 68,2. Bei MathVerse erzielt SRPO-7B 55,8, GRPO-7B 52,9 und Qwen-2.5-VL-7B 46,3. Bei MMMU-Pro liegen die Werte bei 42,3 für SRPO-7B, 39,9 für GRPO-7B und 36,9 für Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. Bei Physics erreicht SRPO-7B 60,6, GRPO-7B 53,5 und Qwen-2.5-VL-7B 45,4. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe ist SRPO-7B stets der höchste Balken und Qwen-2.5-VL-7B der niedrigste, wobei die exakten Werte als Annotationen über den jeweiligen Balken angezeigt werden. Die Balken sind nicht in auf- oder absteigender Reihenfolge nach Wert sortiert, sondern nach den Benchmark-Kategorien auf der horizontalen Achse angeordnet, und es sind keine einzelnen Balken visuell besonders hervorgehoben. Im Hintergrund des Diagramms ist ein gestricheltes Raster sichtbar, das die Orientierung an den Achsenwerten erleichtert.
